### Connected by kindness

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

[Read more][157]

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

[Learn more][159]

The Avery Dennison Foundation focuses on creating impact where it’s needed most. Through
grantmaking, we support a more thriving world. Watch our new video, illustrating how we foster a
more diverse and sustainable global community.

### Ready for what’s next. ReadyDPP™.

ReadyDPP is Avery Dennison’s integrated, full service solution that seamlessly creates and manages
Digital Product Passports. We reduce the complexity of compliance, giving you total control and
peace of mind to focus on whatever’s next for your brand.

[Learn more][158]

### Anti-dew protective overlay

Dew can cut sign reflectivity by 60% at night, risking safety. Avery Dennison OL-1200 clear overlay
film prevents dew droplets from forming, maintaining optimal visibility and sign reliability.

## Company Overview

Glen Raven is a family-owned global textile company founded in 1880, whose portfolio of
category-leading brands — including Sunbrella, Dickson, GlenGuard, and Trivantage — serves customers
across 126 countries through performance fabrics, protective apparel, and distribution.

[ View Full Brochure ][27]

## Our Markets

Our market solutions weave the experiences found in everyday life. We're an industry leader
inspiring and empowering people to express their unique styles. At Glen Raven, we listen and provide
the tools to bring creative visions to life. [ Learn More ][28]

Our Purpose

## Enriching The Fabric of Life

At Glen Raven, we orient around a shared purpose: “Weaving Connections That Keep the World
Spinning.” This purpose puts people first, enabling us to create moments of connection – between
thinking and experience, art and science, people and ideas, individuals and communities. It reminds
us of the important role we play in the lives of the people and communities that our products touch
every day, making decisions clearer, business more worthwhile, and fueling the culture for our
business, for our customers, for our employees. 

[ About Us ][34]

> "Glen Raven is committed to improving the lives of our associates, enriching our communities, and
> preserving our planet."
> 
> [Leib Oehmig] Leib Oehmig Chief Executive Officer, Glen Raven, Inc.

[Contact Us][65]
The leader in performance fabrics

# Herculite® manufactures flexible PVC composite textiles for applications that demand exceptional
# aesthetics, durability, and return on investment.

[[About Herculite]][66]
[Our Products][67]
Powered by Innovation, Proven by Performance

Herculite is a pioneer in the flexible PVC composite textiles industry. We’ve been producing the
highest-quality fabrics, print media, and more for over 60 years. All of our products are developed,
produced, and checked for quality right here in the U.S.A.

Herculite products are made to last and create minimal environmental impact. From raw materials to
recycling, we believe that doing what’s right for our customers and what’s right for the planet are
one and the same.

[Our Story][68]
Our Products
Awning Fabrics
Architectural awnings designed with Herculite's® Awning Fabrics provide extra outdoor living and
extended seasonal space, protect interior furnishings from fading and ultra violet damage.
[Explore][69]
Performance Fabrics
Proven solutions for military, agriculture, and other demanding industries. Custom-engineered
fabrics available.
[Explore][70]
Healthcare Fabrics
Sure-Chek® brand medical fabrics are the original health care fabrics that were patented for use as
protective covering fabrics and today are the standard in the industry.
[Explore][71]

## Improve Yields, Reduce Labor and Increase Profitability

When you work with Marlen, you’re partnering with a top global manufacturer of highly engineered
food processing equipment and systems. Our equipment delivers outstanding performance in our
customers’ facilities coupled with top-notch service and responsiveness from our nationwide
Lifecycle Services network of master technicians. That’s why leading food brands collaborate and
partner with us to create custom food processing solutions for their business.

Deli meat processor saw a 3.2-month payback with an annual savings in excess of $1.5M
A customer improved finish cook yield by 10%
The shelf-life of a retail product was extended by 30%

# Protecting people and their belongings

Shaping your future with technical textiles

## Creating a safer world with Sioen

Welcome to Sioen, where we do more than just make fabrics — we innovate safety. Leading the way in
technical textiles, we design essential solutions for sectors including firefighting, construction,
and maritime. From pioneering PVC-coated textiles to developing durable geotextiles, our creations
ensure quality and reliability.
* Global reach
  
  Sioen's technical textiles and protective wear are trusted by professionals worldwide. Our
  extensive network ensures that our innovative solutions are accessible in every corner of the
  globe.
* Quality Control
  
  Our rigorous testing processes and state-of-the-art facilities guarantee that every product not
  only meets but exceeds global standards, ensuring reliability in every thread.
* Research & Innovation
  
  Our dedicated teams dive deep into the science of textiles, pioneering new materials and
  techniques that redefine industry standards and push the boundaries of what's possible.

# Protecting people and their belongings

Shaping your future with technical textiles

## Creating a safer world with Sioen

Welcome to Sioen, where we do more than just make fabrics — we innovate safety. Leading the way in
technical textiles, we design essential solutions for sectors including firefighting, construction,
and maritime. From pioneering PVC-coated textiles to developing durable geotextiles, our creations
ensure quality and reliability.
* Global reach
  
  Sioen's technical textiles and protective wear are trusted by professionals worldwide. Our
  extensive network ensures that our innovative solutions are accessible in every corner of the
  globe.
* Quality Control
  
  Our rigorous testing processes and state-of-the-art facilities guarantee that every product not
  only meets but exceeds global standards, ensuring reliability in every thread.
* Research & Innovation
  
  Our dedicated teams dive deep into the science of textiles, pioneering new materials and
  techniques that redefine industry standards and push the boundaries of what's possible.

## 120-year Anniversary

From our founding to today, Trelleborg has been shaped by innovation, resilience and the people who
made it all possible.
[Join us in honoring the journey][28]
[Wind turbines representing renewable energy and sustainability]

## Sustainability leader in our industry

Trelleborg’s products and solutions have unique properties that protect the essential. We are
committed to contributing to a more sustainable development and society, which means taking
responsibility for our environmental and social impact throughout the value chain.  
[Sustainability][29]
[Employees collaborating in a meeting]

## Shaping Industry From the Inside

Trelleborg foster a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute, characterized by clear
leadership and accountability. We believe every employee has the potential to make a meaningful
impact and shape industry from the inside. 

[Meet us][30]

## Contact Us

Get the expert advice and answers you need within our global group network.
[Contact Trelleborg][31]
[Employees outside Trelleborg headquarters]

## FAQ
* What does Trelleborg specialize in?
  Trelleborg Group specialize in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique solutions portfolio
  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad
  expertise make us a world leader in engineered polymer solutions.
* Which industries does Trelleborg serve?
  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.
  [Your Industry][32]
* What is Trelleborg’s strategic focus?
  Trelleborg focus on leading positions in selected segments. We make an overall assessment based on
  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.
  
* Where does Trelleborg operate?
  Trelleborg operate globally through state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, sales
  offices, and distribution networks. We strive to maintain a strong physical presence close to our
  customers.
* What types of solutions does Trelleborg offer?
  Trelleborg engineers complete polymer-based solutions that enhance performance, efficiency and
  sustainability. Through innovation, application expertise and close customer partnerships, we
  strengthen performance and drive sustainable growth.
  [Our Solutions][33]

# Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion

We Solve Your Challenge

[ Get in touch! ][49]

###### about us

## AerO Coated Fabrics

We produce high end Extrusion Coating & Film Extrusion with PVC, PP, PE, LDPE, TPU, TPV, TPO, SBR,
PET and more. Woven as well as Non-Woven technical textiles can be used as a carrier. Our products:
dancing floors, flexible acoustic separating curtains, conveyor belts, sewage pipe renovation
(CIPP), concrete silo protection, pool covers, cow mattresses, solar films, construction/profile
moulds, rubber packings and many more coating solutions. We have a variety of profile rollers to
create different embossings. All of which is specially developed for specific needs for you as a
customer.

You could describe AerO Coated Fabrics as being: modern, ambitious, R&D focused, capable of offering
flexibility in manufacturing Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion, short delivery times, smaller
production runs, excellent service, and use of our „expertise and experience“ to deliver a high
quality product.

**That is why we dare to say: “We solve your challenge”**

###### send a message

## Contact request

Bericht: JavaScript is vereist voor deze inhoud.

### Extrusion calender technology,
### by Aero Coated Fabrics

## Our products

###### Sewer renovation CIPP

###### Agriculture

###### Indoor Sports

###### Construction & Architecture

###### Theatre, Dance & Events

###### Industry

###### Swimming Pool & wellness

###### Film and Foils & Welding tapes

###### Contract Coating

## Production

Our extrusion coating calendar machine is a process to coat directly a foil or film onto a technical
fabric / textile woven or non-woven. The coating adds special properties such as waterproofing,
flame resistant, abrasion resistance, non-slip, antistatic and printable. Our coating solutions also
offers protection against wind, water, cold and chemicals. With our state of the art extrusion
machine we are able to process all sorts of polymers:

TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane), PE (PolyEthylene), PP (PolyPropylene), TPO (Thermoplastic Olefin),
TPE (Thermoplastic Elastomer), SBR (Styrene Butadiene Rubber), PVC-P (Plasticized Poly Vinyl
Chloride), PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate), EVA (EthylVinylAcetate) and other polymers.

[ Read more ][50]
[Extrusion Coating - Aero Coated fabrics]

## Sustainability

AerO Coated Fabrics extrusion coating is a clean manufacturing process, no liquids are used and all
raw materials are in granulate form making it impossible to contaminate the environment. Also a
closed loop system is in place for waste and off cuts for most manufactured coated fabrics and
non-wovens. Reducing waste is key and already very effective due to the availability of the newest
technologies.

[ Read more ][51]

## Development

AerO Coated Fabrics offers the option to work with you from development of new combination of
fabrics and coatings to certifications of Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion. Generally speaking
we are co-operating to develop solutions for new applications and improvements of existing products.
Our laboratory is equipped for controlling mechanical properties like tensile strength, elongation,
adhesion, tear strength, resistance to abrasion and permeability.

[ Read more ][52]

AerO Coated Fabrics is a modern, ambitious & R&D focused company. Capable offering flexibility in
manufacturing Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion, short delivery times, smaller production runs
with excellent service. That is why we dare to say: “**We solve your challenge**”

flame resistant, abrasion resistance, non-slip, antistatic and printable. Our coating solutions also
offers protection against wind, water, cold and chemicals. With our state of the art extrusion
machine we are able to process all sorts of polymers:

TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane), PE (PolyEthylene), PP (PolyPropylene), TPO (Thermoplastic Olefin),
TPE (Thermoplastic Elastomer), SBR (Styrene Butadiene Rubber), PVC-P (Plasticized Poly Vinyl
Chloride), PET (Polyethylene Terephthalate), EVA (EthylVinylAcetate) and other polymers.

[ Read more ][50]
[Extrusion Coating - Aero Coated fabrics]

## Sustainability

AerO Coated Fabrics extrusion coating is a clean manufacturing process, no liquids are used and all
raw materials are in granulate form making it impossible to contaminate the environment. Also a
closed loop system is in place for waste and off cuts for most manufactured coated fabrics and
non-wovens. Reducing waste is key and already very effective due to the availability of the newest
technologies.

[ Read more ][51]

## Development

AerO Coated Fabrics offers the option to work with you from development of new combination of
fabrics and coatings to certifications of Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion. Generally speaking
we are co-operating to develop solutions for new applications and improvements of existing products.
Our laboratory is equipped for controlling mechanical properties like tensile strength, elongation,
adhesion, tear strength, resistance to abrasion and permeability.

[ Read more ][52]

AerO Coated Fabrics is a modern, ambitious & R&D focused company. Capable offering flexibility in
manufacturing Extrusion Coating and Film Extrusion, short delivery times, smaller production runs
with excellent service. That is why we dare to say: “**We solve your challenge**”

Cady Bag Company has evolved from producing mesh bags for citrus stands to a global leader in woven
polypropylene fabrics, driven by innovation and a commitment to customer satisfaction, while
maintaining its roots in South Georgia values.
[ Read more ][26]

What We Offer

## PP Bags Manufacturers

Cady Bag company is a vertical integrated manufacturer of polypropylene fabrics & bags for a wide
variety of end uses. Products include mesh bags for produce, specialty bags, agriculture bags and
geotextile fabrics for niche markets. Our 5 main business units are listed below.

### Consumer Packaging

Our Consumer BOPP Packaging division uses laminated fabrics with high resolution graphics Biaxially
Oriented Polypropylene Bags.

[Learn more][27]

### Cotton Bale Packaging

At our cotton bale packaging manufacturing facility, we specialize in producing durable and reliable
packaging solutions.

[Learn more][28]

### Leno Packaging

We are a top US manufacturer of high-quality, reliable and efficient Leno bags for packaging your
onions, nuts, shellfish, citrus, or firewood.

[Learn more][29]

### Coated Fabrics

Cady utilizes our wide web coating & lamination capabilities to service the wide spectrum
requirements associated with our end-use markets.

[Learn more][30]

### Do you have a packaging requirement that you cannot fulfil?

If so, Cady Bag is your perfect supply partner for woven polypropylene bags manufacturer. Our global
sourcing network division buys materials in bulk and sells them in smaller quantities. Our expertise
lies in sourcing the materials you want through our global network of suppliers.

[ Get a quote ][31]

Cady Bag Company is a vertically integrated manufacturer of flexible packaging and fabrics for niche
markets.

We reside in South Georgia and provide superior quality, customer service, and lead times. We speak
your language, use your currency, and adhere to the laws and EPA regulations of the USA, just like
you.
* Providing our customers with the highest quality products in the industry.
* Creating an atmosphere in which our employees can reach their full potential.
* Containing both customer and industry confidence in our products and commitment.
* At our company, we are committed to delivering maximum value for a fair price.

Cady Bag had been an excellent business partner. Being here in South Georgia they have help us
tremendously in some short turn around challenges. Local and friendly, that’s how we like to do
business.

**Regional Pet Food producer** / Operations Manager

Made in America is important to my business. We are farmers and support USA produced product when we
can. Cady’s integrated bag making operations in Georgia allow us to plan our business better and
delivery is three weeks vs. months. Honesty, quality and integrity, if they are important to your
business Cady is the answer.

**Large Scale Farming Operation** / Owner

My business is very seasonal and inventory management is key. In working with Cady, I can order just
the amount of product that I need to get through the season and not get caught with tremendous
inventory carry over. Cady has great flexibility regarding production quantities, sometimes I need
just a few pallets to finish my year. Cady the answer.

**Vidalia Onion Grower**

We have been doing business with the Cady Team for over 50 years. They treat us like family. We
purchase packaging on a global scale, but nobody treats us like our friends at Cady Bag.

**Northeast Packaging Distributor**

Made in America is important to my business. We are farmers and support USA produced product when we
can. Cady’s integrated bag making operations in Georgia allow us to plan our business better and
delivery is three weeks vs. months. Honesty, quality and integrity, if they are important to your
business Cady is the answer.

**Large Scale Farming Operation** / Owner

My business is very seasonal and inventory management is key. In working with Cady, I can order just
the amount of product that I need to get through the season and not get caught with tremendous
inventory carry over. Cady has great flexibility regarding production quantities, sometimes I need
just a few pallets to finish my year. Cady the answer.

**Vidalia Onion Grower**

We have been doing business with the Cady Team for over 50 years. They treat us like family. We
purchase packaging on a global scale, but nobody treats us like our friends at Cady Bag.

# WELCOME TO CARRINGTON TEXTILES

We are a **global workwear textile manufacturer exporting to more than 80 countries**, and producing
**130 million metres of fabric annually** as a group, from our factories in **Pakistan, Portugal and
the UK**.

Throughout Europe, the Middle East, Australasia, and beyond, millions of people go about their tasks
in workwear made from our fabrics.

**Read more**

We specialise in the development of fabrics and finishes with exceptional performance in the most
demanding workplace environments. As a result, we have a reputation for innovation, and continue to
introduce exciting breakthroughs.

We develop new ideas to meet the most stringent performance requirements encountered in diverse
areas such as heavy industry, light engineering, food processing, retail, distribution,
pharmaceutical, healthcare and defence.

# WELCOME TO CARRINGTON TEXTILES

We are a **global workwear textile manufacturer exporting to more than 80 countries**, and producing
**130 million metres of fabric annually** as a group, from our factories in **Pakistan, Portugal and
the UK**.

Throughout Europe, the Middle East, Australasia, and beyond, millions of people go about their tasks
in workwear made from our fabrics.

**Read more**

We specialise in the development of fabrics and finishes with exceptional performance in the most
demanding workplace environments. As a result, we have a reputation for innovation, and continue to
introduce exciting breakthroughs.

We develop new ideas to meet the most stringent performance requirements encountered in diverse
areas such as heavy industry, light engineering, food processing, retail, distribution,
pharmaceutical, healthcare and defence.

[Workwear Image]

### Workwear

Our workwear fabrics are the perfect solution for virtually any industry.

[Flame Retardant Image]

### Flame Retardant

We are one of the biggest flame retardant fabric manufacturers in the world.

[EXPLORE][119]
[Defence Image]

### Defence

We are one of the biggest military fabric suppliers and the only Multicam licensee in Europe.

[EXPLORE][120]
[Waterproof Image]

### Waterproof

A wide range of PU coated and laminated textiles for the best waterproof fabrics.

[EXPLORE][121]
[Sustainable Image]

### Sustainable

Environmentally friendly fabrics with recycled polyester, sustainable cotton and much more.

[EXPLORE][122]

[Celebrating 150 Years. CGT Est. 1869]

## CGT–The Perfect Finish

Since 1869, CGT has been one of the world’s leading producers of polymeric coated fabrics and films
for automotive and industrial applications in the global marketplace.

CGT has its roots in the Victoria Wheel Works which provided wagon wheels for the thriving
transportation trade of the time. CGT was a major supplier of coated fabrics during the war years
(rain wear) and consumer products (shower curtains, wall coverings and tablecloths). We are proud of
our roots and excited about the future as we continue to deliver first-class quality automotive and
industrial coated fabrics and films.

## CGT–The Perfect Finish

Since 1869, CGT has been one of the world’s leading producers of polymeric coated fabrics and films
for automotive and industrial applications in the global marketplace.

CGT has its roots in the Victoria Wheel Works which provided wagon wheels for the thriving
transportation trade of the time. CGT was a major supplier of coated fabrics during the war years
(rain wear) and consumer products (shower curtains, wall coverings and tablecloths). We are proud of
our roots and excited about the future as we continue to deliver first-class quality automotive and
industrial coated fabrics and films.

# Welcome to Chemprene! A beacon of innovation in the rubber product manufacturing industry.

With over seven decades of expertise, Chemprene, Inc. has established itself as a premier
manufacturer of rubber coated textiles, including **Lightweight Rubber Conveyor Belting**, **Coated
Fabrics**, **Diaphragms**, and an array of precision molded products. Our commitment to quality is
unwavering and our objective is to consistently produce the highest caliber rubber products for a
broad spectrum of needs in the commercial, industrial, and consumer sectors worldwide.

Our journey began over 75 years ago in Beacon, NY, where we initially focused on military-coated
fabric products. Over time, our product line evolved to encompass automotive and specialty diaphragm
applications, with conveyor belting, joining our offerings in the mid-1960s. Today, Chemprene
proudly manufactures these product lines in our expansive 225,000 sq. ft. facility, equipped with
cutting-edge rubber coating and curing technologies. This allows us to merge a vast selection of
elastomeric materials with various substrates, crafting products that rise to the challenges of the
most demanding applications.

As a proud member of the AMMEGA Group, Chemprene is dedicated to continuous improvement, leveraging
Statistical Process Control, Lean Manufacturing, and 6S Fundamentals to enhance our operations. Our
ISO 9001:2015 certification is a testament to our commitment to excellence, serving a global
clientele across critical sectors such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, and distribution.
AMMEGA’s recent $100M investment underscores our promise to lead the industry forward, ensuring that
Chemprene remains synonymous with quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction for years to come.

At Chemprene, innovation is crucial in meeting our customers’ needs. Therefore, if our existing
products do not align with your specific requirements, our dedicated technical staff is ready to
collaborate on new product development, guiding you from the initial design phase to full-scale
commercial production. Join us in our mission to shape the future of rubber product manufacturing,
where every challenge is an opportunity to excel and reinforce our legacy of innovation and
commitment to American manufacturing excellence!

## 1950

# Founding and Early Innovations.

Chemprene, originally Chemical Rubber Products, was founded by Tom Martini, Dan Donovan, and Bill
Shephard in Beacon, NY. Specialized in coated fabrics for government applications.

## 1960

# Expansion and New Markets.

Entered diaphragm manufacturing together with the belting market with advanced belt curing
machinery.

## 1964

# Acquisition and Rebranding.

Acquired by the Richardson Company and rebranded as Chemprene, Inc. Significant expansion and growth
followed.

## 1972

# New Facility and Community Commitment.

Established the current facility at 483 Fishkill Avenue, Beacon, NY. Maintained operations within
the same community, reflecting dedication to the local workforce.

## 1982

# New Ownership and Resources.

Acquired by the New York-based Witco Corporation. Introduction of new resources and opportunities.

## 1997

# Integration into Ammeraal.

Integrated into Ammeraal, a subsidiary of Gamma Holding, enhancing its strategic position in the
market.
Chemprene’s development of ZipLink technology solidified its commitment to industry leadership in
producing conveyor belts, enhancing their durability and performance.

## 2000

# Merger and Facility Expansion.

Ammeraal & Verseidag Beltech merged into Ammeraal Beltech.
Chemprene’s facilities were expanded to over 220,000 square feet with state-of-the-art
administrative, manufacturing, and laboratory spaces, maintaining complete control over rubber
production, and ensuring high-quality standards.

## 2018

# Integration into AMMEGA.

Acquired by Partners Group, Ammeraal Beltech and Megadyne joined under single ownership and
leadership, establishing AMMEGA as a premier entity in the belting industry.

## 2020

# Investment and Future Commitment.

Reinforced infrastructure and capabilities embracing our “Built American Proud” (BAP) policy,
ensuring readiness for future advancements!

## 1950

# Founding and Early Innovations.

Chemprene, originally Chemical Rubber Products, was founded by Tom Martini, Dan Donovan, and Bill
Shephard in Beacon, NY. Specialized in coated fabrics for government applications.

## 1960

# Expansion and New Markets.

Entered diaphragm manufacturing together with the belting market with advanced belt curing
machinery.

## 1964

# Acquisition and Rebranding.

Acquired by the Richardson Company and rebranded as Chemprene, Inc. Significant expansion and growth
followed.

## 1972

# New Facility and Community Commitment.

Established the current facility at 483 Fishkill Avenue, Beacon, NY. Maintained operations within
the same community, reflecting dedication to the local workforce.

## 1982

# New Ownership and Resources.

Acquired by the New York-based Witco Corporation. Introduction of new resources and opportunities.

## 1997

# Integration into Ammeraal.

Integrated into Ammeraal, a subsidiary of Gamma Holding, enhancing its strategic position in the
market.
Chemprene’s development of ZipLink technology solidified its commitment to industry leadership in
producing conveyor belts, enhancing their durability and performance.

## 2000

# Merger and Facility Expansion.

Ammeraal & Verseidag Beltech merged into Ammeraal Beltech.
Chemprene’s facilities were expanded to over 220,000 square feet with state-of-the-art
administrative, manufacturing, and laboratory spaces, maintaining complete control over rubber
production, and ensuring high-quality standards.

## 2018

# Integration into AMMEGA.

Acquired by Partners Group, Ammeraal Beltech and Megadyne joined under single ownership and
leadership, establishing AMMEGA as a premier entity in the belting industry.

## 2020

# Investment and Future Commitment.

Reinforced infrastructure and capabilities embracing our “Built American Proud” (BAP) policy,
ensuring readiness for future advancements!

# OUR KNOW-HOW : Rubber coated fabrics & rubber sheets manufacturer

COLMANT COATED FABRICS designs, manufactures and commercializes rubber **coated fabrics and rubber
sheets**. The rubbers formulated by our laboratories include the best-quality elastomers (commonly
known as rubbers) and plastomers (commonly known as plastics).

Our domain of expertise includes :
* **Formulating the appropriate rubber** matching the customer’s specifications
* **Defining the technical textile** to meet the customer’s requirements
* **Calendering the polymers/rubbers** and/or technical textiles in order to produce sheets or
  coated fabrics for our customers.
* **Proposing technical rubber coated fabrics and rubber sheets for innovative projects** respecting
  our customer’s restrictions.

COLMANT COATED FABRICS initiates a dialog with the customers to analyze the different purposes and
performance criterias required to define the best product.

# OUR KNOW-HOW : Rubber coated fabrics & rubber sheets manufacturer

COLMANT COATED FABRICS designs, manufactures and commercializes rubber **coated fabrics and rubber
sheets**. The rubbers formulated by our laboratories include the best-quality elastomers (commonly
known as rubbers) and plastomers (commonly known as plastics).

Our domain of expertise includes :
* **Formulating the appropriate rubber** matching the customer’s specifications
* **Defining the technical textile** to meet the customer’s requirements
* **Calendering the polymers/rubbers** and/or technical textiles in order to produce sheets or
  coated fabrics for our customers.
* **Proposing technical rubber coated fabrics and rubber sheets for innovative projects** respecting
  our customer’s restrictions.

COLMANT COATED FABRICS initiates a dialog with the customers to analyze the different purposes and
performance criterias required to define the best product.

ancient Egyptians excelled in weaving and dying flax fibers since their early ages.
Due to their importance and high price, the writing fabrics  were inherited to descendants. The
Egyptian fabrics had gained fame till Ptolemy Age.
Nowadays weaving and  textile industry is considered one of the most important and oldest Egyptian
industries. It represents a big ratio of the Egyptian exports.
Thousands of workers are employed in this industry and they represent a big percentage of the
manpower  volume in the Egyptian Market. They are distributed to hundreds of factories ranging from
public to private sector to Investment ones which are partially owned by foreigners as per the
ceiling of foreign ownership decided by the investment Guarantee Law in Egypt in addition to the
family sector and the hundreds of the small individual establishments.

[ Healthcare ][69]
[Close-up of a person's knee wearing a grey knitted compression brace. The person is wearing dark
athletic shorts and a black fingerless workout glove.]

### Healthcare

Eastex Products has developed a wide range of technical medical fabrics, neoprene sheeting, and hook
and loop fastening systems to meet the needs of medical and orthopedic soft goods manufacturers. Our
medical grade fabrics include:

• spacer fabrics
• fluid-proof fabrics in stretch and non-stretch
• non-slip fabrics
• anti-microbial fabrics
• custom laminations for a wide variety of healthcare applications

## About Us

# One of India’s leading players in the technical textiles sector.

Established in 1976, the company today is a multi-divisional, multi-geographical technical textiles
company and is known for providing world-class innovative solutions in high-performance aquaculture
cage nets, fishing nets, sports nets, safety nets, agricultural nets, coated fabrics, synthetic
ropes and geosynthetics.

## About Us

# One of India’s leading players in the technical textiles sector.

Established in 1976, the company today is a multi-divisional, multi-geographical technical textiles
company and is known for providing world-class innovative solutions in high-performance aquaculture
cage nets, fishing nets, sports nets, safety nets, agricultural nets, coated fabrics, synthetic
ropes and geosynthetics.

# Performance Waterproof Textiles, Coated Fabrics & Reflective Tapes

## PERFORMANCE WORKWEAR FABRICS

Waterproof Ripstop Nylon & Polyester Fabrics

[100% Polyester Knitted]

## LEISUREWEAR AND SPORTS FABRICS

Waterproof Polyester and Fleece Sportswear Fabrics

## MEDICAL & HOSPITAL FABRICS

Quick dry Mesh & Slip Sheet Fabrics for Patient Care

## HIGH PERFORMANCE REFLECTIVE TAPES

Flame Resistant, Sew-On, Chevron, Heat Applied, Prismatic

# COATED FABRICS FOR PROFESSIONAL INDUSTRIES

The Henderson Textiles fabric range is an extensive stock supported portfolio and includes coated
fabrics for many professional industries including Protective Clothing, Military, Emergency
Services, Garden Furniture and Apparel.

## EXTREME SPORT FABRICS

Ripstop Nylons, Polyesters and Nylons

## GARDEN FURNITURE

Nylons, Polyester & Coated Fabrics

## MARQUEES & TENT FABRICS

Flame Resistant Nylons & Polyesters

## THEATRE/BACKDROP FABRICS

Flame Resistant Linings & Drapes

## PROTECTIVE & WORKWEAR

Flame Resistant, Ballistic & Polyesters

## MILITARY GRADE FABRICS

Flame Resistant, Ballistic & Ripstops

## EMS UNIFORM FABRICS

Hi-Vizibility, Polyesters & Nylons

## OTHER FABRICS & ACCESSORIES

Trims, Reflective Tapes and Badges

# WHY HENDERSON? 52 YEARS OF COATED PERFORMANCE TEXTILES

Henderson Textiles was established in 1957 and has been trading for over 52 years. We specialise in
Coated Fabrics including Performance Waterproof Workwear fabrics, Leisure and Sports fabrics and
Waterproof Industrial Protective fabrics. We export our coated fabrics worldwide to a wide range of
end users – from Bouncy Castle and Kite manufacturers to Foul Weather and Industrial Garment Makers.
At Henderson Textiles, we have been successful at building up a good reputation with our customers
for being able to adapt to the ever changing Textile Market. We listen to our customers and provide
not only an extensive coated fabric stock service but also an excellent level of customer service,
which we pride ourselves on.

## 52 Years of Service

Henderson Textiles was established in 1957 and specialise in Performance Waterproof Textiles &
Coated Fabrics.

## Stock Holding

Stock Supported fabrics ready for delivery from our Manchester Distribution facilities.

## Next Day Shipping

Next Day Shipping to UK Destinations using reputable couriers.

## European Shipping

Shipping our Performance Fabrics to manufacturers throughout Europe.

## Personal Service

Personal Service and Dependability from Henderson Textiles comes as standard.

## Converter

Many fabrics within the product range can be converted to your requirements.

# BROWSE THE PRODUCT RANGE ONLINE

Henderson Textiles provide a Stock Supported service on Hundreds of coated fabrics fabrics for
industry. For the first time, you can now discover the ranges available from our Manchester
Distribution warehouse by browsing this website. To place your order, please contact our Sales
Office.

## JoAnn Fabrics FAQs

Common questions about JoAnn fabric stores, products, and services

What types of fabric does JoAnn sell? +
JoAnn Fabrics offers an extensive selection of fabrics by the yard including premium quilting
cotton, fleece fabric for cozy projects, flannel for pajamas and baby items, knit fabrics for
comfortable clothing, canvas for home decor and upholstery, seasonal prints including Christmas
fabric, cotton prints and solids, specialty fabrics like silk and satin, and much more. With
thousands of JoAnn fabric varieties in every color and pattern, you’ll find the perfect material for
any sewing or quilting project.
Does JoAnn sell Red Heart yarn and other yarn brands? +
Yes! JoAnn carries an incredible selection of yarn including popular brands like Red Heart (Super
Saver, Soft, and more), Caron (Simply Soft is a customer favorite), Big Twist (JoAnn’s exclusive
brand), Lion Brand, Bernat, and many other trusted yarn brands. JoAnn stocks yarn in every weight
from super fine to super bulky, in various fiber contents including acrylic, cotton, wool blends,
and specialty fibers for all your knitting and crochet projects.
Where can I find a JoAnn store near me? +
JoAnn operates over 860 store locations across 49 states in the United States. You can use the JoAnn
store locator on their website to find your nearest JoAnn Fabrics store, check store hours, and get
directions. Many JoAnn locations also offer convenient in-store pickup for online orders. Whether
you prefer shopping at your local JoAnn store or online, you’ll have access to thousands of fabrics,
yarn, and craft supplies.
What sewing machines does JoAnn carry? +
JoAnn Fabrics carries top sewing machine brands including Singer, Brother, Janome, and JoAnn’s own
brand machines. The selection ranges from basic mechanical sewing machines perfect for beginners to
advanced computerized models for experienced sewers. JoAnn’s knowledgeable staff can help you choose
the right sewing machine for your skill level and project needs, whether you’re just starting out or
looking to upgrade your equipment.
Does JoAnn offer coupons and a rewards program? +
Yes! JoAnn offers regular sales, valuable coupons, and a free rewards program to help your crafting
budget go further. You can find JoAnn coupons on their website, mobile app, email newsletters, and
in-store flyers. The JoAnn rewards program is free to join and gives you access to exclusive offers,
birthday rewards, and points on purchases that convert to certificates for future savings on

## JoAnn Fabrics FAQs

Common questions about JoAnn fabric stores, products, and services

What types of fabric does JoAnn sell? +
JoAnn Fabrics offers an extensive selection of fabrics by the yard including premium quilting
cotton, fleece fabric for cozy projects, flannel for pajamas and baby items, knit fabrics for
comfortable clothing, canvas for home decor and upholstery, seasonal prints including Christmas
fabric, cotton prints and solids, specialty fabrics like silk and satin, and much more. With
thousands of JoAnn fabric varieties in every color and pattern, you’ll find the perfect material for
any sewing or quilting project.
Does JoAnn sell Red Heart yarn and other yarn brands? +
Yes! JoAnn carries an incredible selection of yarn including popular brands like Red Heart (Super
Saver, Soft, and more), Caron (Simply Soft is a customer favorite), Big Twist (JoAnn’s exclusive
brand), Lion Brand, Bernat, and many other trusted yarn brands. JoAnn stocks yarn in every weight
from super fine to super bulky, in various fiber contents including acrylic, cotton, wool blends,
and specialty fibers for all your knitting and crochet projects.
Where can I find a JoAnn store near me? +
JoAnn operates over 860 store locations across 49 states in the United States. You can use the JoAnn
store locator on their website to find your nearest JoAnn Fabrics store, check store hours, and get
directions. Many JoAnn locations also offer convenient in-store pickup for online orders. Whether
you prefer shopping at your local JoAnn store or online, you’ll have access to thousands of fabrics,
yarn, and craft supplies.
What sewing machines does JoAnn carry? +
JoAnn Fabrics carries top sewing machine brands including Singer, Brother, Janome, and JoAnn’s own
brand machines. The selection ranges from basic mechanical sewing machines perfect for beginners to
advanced computerized models for experienced sewers. JoAnn’s knowledgeable staff can help you choose
the right sewing machine for your skill level and project needs, whether you’re just starting out or
looking to upgrade your equipment.
Does JoAnn offer coupons and a rewards program? +
Yes! JoAnn offers regular sales, valuable coupons, and a free rewards program to help your crafting
budget go further. You can find JoAnn coupons on their website, mobile app, email newsletters, and
in-store flyers. The JoAnn rewards program is free to join and gives you access to exclusive offers,
birthday rewards, and points on purchases that convert to certificates for future savings on
fabrics, yarn, sewing supplies, and craft materials.
Does JoAnn offer crafting classes? +
Absolutely! Most JoAnn locations host regular free classes and workshops for all skill levels
covering sewing, quilting, knitting, crochet, and various other crafts. JoAnn also provides online
tutorials and instructional content to help you learn new techniques. Check with your local JoAnn

The architecture of modern data centers is changing as rapidly as the workloads they host.

## [The Green Data Center: Cutting Energy Waste With Advanced Thermal Barriers][77]

The rapid growth of cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and digital services has intensified
scrutiny of data center energy consumption. While advances in server technology continue to improve
processing efficiency, cooling remains a major contributor to [...]

[READ OUR LATEST PUBLICATIONS][78]

## REFRACTORY MATERIALS

Manufactured from bulk refractory fibers, THERMOSEAL^{®} refractory cements, refractory coatings,
and refractory moldables are excellent for use in high-temperature resistant sealing and thermal
insulation applications.

All of our THERMOSEAL^{®} thermal insulation products are carefully formulated to withstand thermal
expansion and contraction and have excellent thermal insulation properties, very low shrinkage, and
high strength.

Our refractory cements are available in thick paste or thick cement consistencies. Our refractory
coatings come as paste or paint, and our refractory moldables are available as putty, mixes, or
pastes.

## About Us

Mid-Mountain Materials, Inc. is an ISO 9001:2015 certified manufacturer of engineered thermal
insulation barriers and seals that provide environmental protection, emissions control, and energy
conservation.

[More about us..][68]

### FROM AEROSPACE TO WELDING.

Mid-Mountain Materials, Inc. has been engineering and manufacturing solutions for high-temperature
resistant applications in industries around the globe for forty years.

[Find out more][69]

### PIONEERING NEW PRODUCTS.

Research and Development is at the core of what we do, and developing close relationships with our
customers allows us the opportunity to provide high-temperature resistant solutions specifically
suited to a unique application.

[Find out more][70]

### CUSTOMER DRIVEN. INNOVATIVE. EXPERIENCED.

Since 1976, our mission has remained firm: to be the most innovative and competitive manufacturer of
high-temperature resistant materials, exceeding our customers’ expectations of quality, service and
product performance.

[Find out more][71]

### BEST PRACTICES. ASSURANCE. SATISFACTION.

Exceeding customer expectations with exceptional service and high quality, high-temperature
resistant products. Mid-Mountain was built on this principle, and our ISO 9001:2015 certification
demonstrates our commitment to quality management.

[Find out more][72]

## Blog & Media

articles detailing our products and solutions, and in the media section you can view interactive
resources highlighted by Mid-Mountain.

## REFRACTORY MATERIALS

Manufactured from bulk refractory fibers, THERMOSEAL^{®} refractory cements, refractory coatings,
and refractory moldables are excellent for use in high-temperature resistant sealing and thermal
insulation applications.

All of our THERMOSEAL^{®} thermal insulation products are carefully formulated to withstand thermal
expansion and contraction and have excellent thermal insulation properties, very low shrinkage, and
high strength.

Our refractory cements are available in thick paste or thick cement consistencies. Our refractory

# «MultiTex» — Manufacturer of Flame Retardant Coated Fabrics

## Browse
* Home


“Multitex” company has been developing and producing **unique non-combustible technical fabrics and
impregnations** for more than 8 years.

Our laboratory continuously tests new compositions and production technologies, where highly
qualified specialists on modern equipment are ready to develop materials according to your
requirements.

[ [Equipment for coating the fabric of the company "Multitex" (photo)][Equipment for coating the
fabric of the company "Multitex" (photo)] ][16]

All products are certified and meet high quality standards.

  shades.

* **Quality.** All products undergo a three-step quality control system and are certified.
* **Competence. **The highest level specialists will help you choose or manufacture the material to
  meet your requirements.

## Innovation By Design

Naugahyde®, the pioneer and premium brand in the coated fabrics industry, is dedicated to
world-class surface pattern design and technical innovation resulting in products with superior
quality, outstanding durability and exceptional performance. Our reputation as a technical innovator
is evident by our leading-edge top coat finishes which offer remarkable stain and abrasion
resistance. All Naugahyde products are proudly made in the U.S.A.

#### Our History

In 1914, an exciting new product was developed at the U.S. Rubber Company plant in Naugatuck,
Connecticut. Since it looked like a hyde and was made in Naugatuck, these two words were linked and
Naugahyde was born.

[Read More about Our History][19]

#### For Designers & Specifiers

Naugahyde products combine style, durability and quality and are available in a variety of designs,
patterns, and colors. Designers and specifiers are encouraged to review products, build design
sheets and order samples.

[Read More about For Designers & Specifiers][20]

## Durable, Stylish & American Made

[A Naugahyde employee pulls fresh product in our manufacturing plant]

Naugahyde, a true American classic, is "Made in the USA" at our Stoughton, Wisconsin manufacturing
plant. We are proud to carry on a tradition of quality craftsmanship and technical innovation that
spans more than 80 years. Our teams, consisting of many long-time employees and even multiple
generations, are dedicated to providing high quality products and outstanding customer service.

## Innovation By Design

Naugahyde®, the pioneer and premium brand in the coated fabrics industry, is dedicated to
world-class surface pattern design and technical innovation resulting in products with superior
quality, outstanding durability and exceptional performance. Our reputation as a technical innovator
is evident by our leading-edge top coat finishes which offer remarkable stain and abrasion
resistance. All Naugahyde products are proudly made in the U.S.A.

#### Our History

In 1914, an exciting new product was developed at the U.S. Rubber Company plant in Naugatuck,
Connecticut. Since it looked like a hyde and was made in Naugatuck, these two words were linked and
Naugahyde was born.

[Read More about Our History][19]

Precision Coating & Coated Fabrics, Tapes, Belts, a Katahdin Industries, Inc. company, is a         
worldwide distributor of PTFE coated fiberglass fabric, PTFE belts, and PTFE tapes. Our proprietary 
PRECISIONFAB™ and PRECISIONTAPE™ products provide exceptional strength, durability, and dimensional 
stability in extreme temperatures. For the finest PTFE coated fabric, PTFE tapes, and PTFE belts    
available today, look no further than Precision Coating & Coated Fabrics, Tapes, Belts.             
                                                                                                    
[**Fiberglass Fabrics**][19]                                                                        
* [**PTFE coated fiberglass fabric**][20] – PRECISIONFAB™ industrial fabrics are made from woven    
  fiberglass cloth with a clear PTFE coating. Our PTFE coated fabrics are non-toxic, odorless,      
  tasteless, and have been cleared by the FDA for use in food processing, packaging, and handling.  
* [**Silicone coated fiberglass fabric**][21] – PRECISIONSIL™ Fiberglass Fabrics are made from woven
  fiberglass substrates that have been coated on one or both sides with silicone rubber.            
  PRECISIONSIL™ offers dimensional stability, durability, excellent tensile strength, and low       
  elongation. The product’s surface friction is much higher than that provided by a fabric coated   
  with PTFE, yet allows the user to retain comparable release characteristics.                      
                                                                                                    
**Fiberglass Belts**                                                                                
* [**PTFE coated fiberglass belts**][22] - Each belt is manufactured from woven fiberglass          
  substrates with an optimal PTFE content, and designed to leave a minimal fabric impression        
* [**Silicone coated fiberglass belts**][23] – Each belt is fabricated from a woven fiberglass cloth
  that has been coated on one or both sides with white or red silicone rubber. This coating,        
  combined with the excellent strength and dimensional stability of the fiberglass, results in a    
  product appropriate for use in a variety of demanding applications.                               
                                                                                                    
**Tape**                                                                                            
* [**PTFE coated fiberglass tape**][24] – PRECISIONTAPE™ industrial tapes are made from woven       
  fiberglass cloth that has been coated with PTFE. Our PTFE coated fiberglass tapes are non-toxic,  
  odorless, tasteless, and have been cleared by the FDA for use in food processing, packaging, and  
  handling.  Our line of industrial PTFE tapes are made to fit your application, whether it is      
  high-temperature (up to 500°F), requiring a silicone adhesive system, or low-temperature (up to   
  275°F), requiring an acrylic adhesive system.                                                     
* [**PTFE film tape**][25] – are made from either a pure unsupported virgin PTFE (PRECISIONSKIVED™) 
  or from ultra-high molecular weight polyolefin (PRECISIONUHMW™). PRECISIONSKIVED™ exhibit the     
  characteristics of our PTFE coated fiberglass tape plus the advantage of being comformable.       
  PRECISIONUHMW™ is more abrasive puncture resistant.  It offers exceptional low friction           
  characteristics than our PTFE coated fiberglass tape. PRECISIONUHMW™ is suitable for applications 
  up to 125°F.                                                                                      
                                                                                                    
[Contact us][26] for more information.                                                              
─

[CONTACT US][12]
We Provide A Variety Of Vinyl For All Your Different Uses And Needs

fabric wholesale so that you can get the material you need at a lower rate. In fact, we don’t just
sell it wholesale, we also offer lower pricing than what you’re likely to find elsewhere on the
market — all while providing you with a superior product.

Hey, we get it — just because you manufacture something that requires PVC material doesn’t mean you
have the resources to produce the PVC material yourself. If you want to ensure that you end up with
the best possible product, you need to work with the best possible materials. At Rhino Tex, we offer
better quality at a better price point so that you can keep your manufacturing costs low.

our high-quality PVC fabric, along with other PVC products such as laminate and PVC mesh.

Whether you’re a manufacturer or a retailer, we even offer coated print material for all of your
marketing needs.

Our products are great because of how much they can withstand. When you choose to buy from Rhino
Tex, you are choosing materials that are fire-resistant, lead-free, UV-resistant, mildew-resistant,
and cold-resistant as low as -40 degrees Fahrenheit. With our materials, you won’t have to worry if
you leave it out in a storm.

# experience. expertise. excellence.

## globally trusted manufacturing hub

[what we do][22]
[our projects][23]

#### Raw Material Supply

We supply a comprehensive range of PVC resins—including specialty resins like Low Gloss and
Copolymer—along with other critical raw materials. With our fleet of bulk trucks, flexible packaging
options, and expertise in LTL (less-than-truckload) shipments, we can support any order size.

#### Extrusion Coating

Our advanced extrusion coating process applies a thin layer of plastic to a base textile (knit or
nonwoven) to achieve specific performance traits, from geomembranes to RV roofing and beyond. We
pioneer new applications by leveraging the latest breakthroughs in polymer chemistry.

#### Film Manufacture

Beyond coating, our lines can produce monolithic films ranging from 1.5 mils to 90 mils thick,
serving industries from geomembrane solutions to diamond plate flooring.

#### Recycling and Packaging Services

We operate an in-house plastics recycling facility at our Pitman, NJ, plant with sifting, grinding,
and sorting capabilities to foster a circular economy. We also buy and sell various grades of PVC
resins, provide break bulk services, and handle import packaging for companies that lack internal
capacity.

#### Ready to Innovate?

Whether you need a customized PVC resin blend or a cutting-edge extrusion coating solution, we’re
here to help you succeed.

[Contact Us Today][24]

## Our Product Range

#### PVC Resin Supply

As North America’s largest distributor of general-purpose and specialty PVC resins, we tailor
formulation and blending to each client’s specifications. From custom packaging options to bulk
break services, we serve large-scale manufacturers and small-to-medium enterprises.

[Learn More][25]

#### XTRM PLY PVC RV Roofing

Developed with the unique demands of RV roofs, our XTRM PLY membrane is ultra-strong, UV-resistant,
and maintenance-free. Designed to withstand extreme temperatures, it stays cool and helps owners
save on energy costs.

[Learn More][26]

#### XTRM PLY PVC Geomembrane

Offering some of the widest widths and best lay-flat capabilities, our PVC geomembranes boast
superior tensile strength and chemical resistance. They shield against acids, oils, methane, and
alkalis, making them ideal for extreme environments.

[Learn More][27]

#### XTRM PLY Diamond Flooring

Made from durable TPO polymer, our diamond plate flooring features a low-profile surface for easy
cleaning, integrated grout lines for seamless repairs, and a nonwoven back for quick and reliable
installation.

[Learn More][28]

#### Toll Coating and R&D

For clients seeking specialized, high-performance materials, we offer toll coating with polymers
like PVC, TPU, TPO, and LLDPE on knit, woven, and nonwoven fabrics. From concept development to
prototype testing, our R&D services bring your vision to life.

[Learn More][29]

#### Fabrication and Prototyping

We can sew vinyl, sheet, and film in our Pitman location for various applications. Not sure of the
exact specs? Our prototyping service helps you test and refine concepts.

[Learn More][30]

## Much More Than a Supplier—Our Story

Founded in 1974 amid a resin shortage, Ronald Mark Associates has grown to be one of North America’s
largest PVC resin suppliers. As a family-owned business, our commitment to quality, innovation, and
customer success has never wavered.

## globally trusted manufacturing hub

[what we do][22]
[our projects][23]

#### Raw Material Supply

We supply a comprehensive range of PVC resins—including specialty resins like Low Gloss and
Copolymer—along with other critical raw materials. With our fleet of bulk trucks, flexible packaging
options, and expertise in LTL (less-than-truckload) shipments, we can support any order size.

#### Extrusion Coating

Our advanced extrusion coating process applies a thin layer of plastic to a base textile (knit or
nonwoven) to achieve specific performance traits, from geomembranes to RV roofing and beyond. We
pioneer new applications by leveraging the latest breakthroughs in polymer chemistry.

#### Film Manufacture

Beyond coating, our lines can produce monolithic films ranging from 1.5 mils to 90 mils thick,
serving industries from geomembrane solutions to diamond plate flooring.

#### Recycling and Packaging Services

We operate an in-house plastics recycling facility at our Pitman, NJ, plant with sifting, grinding,
and sorting capabilities to foster a circular economy. We also buy and sell various grades of PVC
resins, provide break bulk services, and handle import packaging for companies that lack internal
capacity.

#### Ready to Innovate?

Whether you need a customized PVC resin blend or a cutting-edge extrusion coating solution, we’re
here to help you succeed.

## Our Product Range

#### PVC Resin Supply

As North America’s largest distributor of general-purpose and specialty PVC resins, we tailor
formulation and blending to each client’s specifications. From custom packaging options to bulk
break services, we serve large-scale manufacturers and small-to-medium enterprises.

[Learn More][25]

#### XTRM PLY PVC RV Roofing

Developed with the unique demands of RV roofs, our XTRM PLY membrane is ultra-strong, UV-resistant,
and maintenance-free. Designed to withstand extreme temperatures, it stays cool and helps owners
save on energy costs.

[Learn More][26]

#### XTRM PLY PVC Geomembrane

Offering some of the widest widths and best lay-flat capabilities, our PVC geomembranes boast
superior tensile strength and chemical resistance. They shield against acids, oils, methane, and
alkalis, making them ideal for extreme environments.

[Learn More][27]

#### XTRM PLY Diamond Flooring

Made from durable TPO polymer, our diamond plate flooring features a low-profile surface for easy
cleaning, integrated grout lines for seamless repairs, and a nonwoven back for quick and reliable
installation.

[Learn More][28]

#### Toll Coating and R&D

For clients seeking specialized, high-performance materials, we offer toll coating with polymers
like PVC, TPU, TPO, and LLDPE on knit, woven, and nonwoven fabrics. From concept development to
prototype testing, our R&D services bring your vision to life.

[Learn More][29]

#### Fabrication and Prototyping

We can sew vinyl, sheet, and film in our Pitman location for various applications. Not sure of the
exact specs? Our prototyping service helps you test and refine concepts.

[Learn More][30]

devient « Saint Clair Textiles » en 2020 et est spécialisée dans la fabrication de tissus enduits.
Notre savoir-faire dans l’ourdissage, le tissage et l’enduction nous permet de proposer des articles
destinés soit à des usages de confection pour les marchés du transport, de la structure, de
l’environnement ou de l’agriculture, soit à des usages d’impression pour les marchés de la publicité

### Saint-Clair-Textiles

devient « Saint Clair Textiles » en 2020 et est spécialisée dans la fabrication de tissus enduits.
Notre savoir-faire dans l’ourdissage, le tissage et l’enduction nous permet de proposer des articles
destinés soit à des usages de confection pour les marchés du transport, de la structure, de
l’environnement ou de l’agriculture, soit à des usages d’impression pour les marchés de la publicité

## Choose Coated Fabrics, choose Spradling

Coated Fabrics are also the cost-effective choice for the manufacturer who wants to provide the best
quality product in the marketplace at a competitive price.
It’s not hard to keep Coated Fabrics looking like new, even after years of use – coated fabrics and
film can be easily cleaned with soap and water.
Coated Fabrics can be manufactured to provide a barrier to stains, provide antibacterial protection,
and resist mold and mildew build-up.
Coated Fabrics are versatile enough to simulate the look of leather or fabric, or to create an
entirely new and innovative look.
Coated Fabrics, as a material, have inherent fire-resistant properties, promoting consumer safety
and helping manufacturers meet regulations.
Coated Fabrics can be manufactured to be weather-resistant, so they are appropriate for use in both
indoor and outdoor applications.

# SPECIALITY COATINGS FOR FLEXIBLE MATERIALS

## About Stahl

Stahl is a global provider of speciality coatings for flexible materials. Our solutions are the
invisible force behind the everyday materials used in countless industries – from automotive and
apparel to luxury goods, footwear, packaging and home furnishings.

We are a company that creates great consumer experiences. And when people touch our products, we
touch their lives – this is the impact we make each and every day.

We aim to embrace new technologies and enter new sectors to create sustainable coating solutions

# SPECIALITY COATINGS FOR FLEXIBLE MATERIALS

## About Stahl

Stahl is a global provider of speciality coatings for flexible materials. Our solutions are the
invisible force behind the everyday materials used in countless industries – from automotive and
apparel to luxury goods, footwear, packaging and home furnishings.

We are a company that creates great consumer experiences. And when people touch our products, we
touch their lives – this is the impact we make each and every day.

part of something greater – by being connected to the world around us and adding value to people’s

We aim to embrace new technologies and enter new sectors to create sustainable coating solutions
that meet the demands of our changing world. In doing so, we will continue to champion human rights,
inclusion and diversity, and the safety of our people.

## **UK manufactured coated textiles with a great heritage**

Stormproofings Limited is the new trading name being used to consolidate three of the UK’s leading
coated textile companies under one single brand. The re-branding follows the acquisition of the PU
coating side of the Coating Applications Group by Stormproofings Ltd in 2019. The expansion has
resulted in all existing manufacturing, testing and warehousing operating under one roof at the
company’s main site in North Manchester, United Kingdom. The new business will continue to offer a
full range of coated fabrics, commission coating and TPU materials and will also offer the platform
for new developments and opportunities.

For more information, or to receive our latest brochure or product samples, please Contact Us.

### Plain Weave

Basic warp and weft weaving involves interlacing vertical (warp) and horizontal (weft) threads in a
simple over-under pattern, forming durable plain-weave fabrics like canvas, widely used for bags,
shoes, and heavy-duty textiles due to its tight structure and strength.

### Twill Weave

Twill weaving creates diagonal lines by offsetting warp and weft threads in a step-like pattern,
producing durable fabrics like denim, commonly used for jeans, workwear, and jackets due to its
flexibility and abrasion resistance.

### Jacquard Weaving

Complex pattern weaving technology uses computer-controlled looms (e.g., Jacquard or Dobby systems)
to create intricate geometric or artistic designs in textiles, integrating multi-layered color and
texture for luxury apparel, upholstery, or cultural fabrics with digital precision.

### Warp & Weft

The longitudinal and transverse yarns (warp and weft) form fabric's structural base. Warp yarns
(stronger, tightly aligned) run lengthwise, while weft yarns interlace horizontally, defining
texture, drape, and strength. Fiber types (cotton, polyester, silk) and weave patterns shape
material properties for diverse applications.

### Knitting

Knitting is divided into weft (horizontal loops with a single yarn, e.g., T-shirts) and warp
knitting (vertical interlocking with multiple parallel yarns, e.g., lace), differing in elasticity,
unraveling risk, and machinery used for apparel or technical textiles.

### Plain Weave

Basic warp and weft weaving involves interlacing vertical (warp) and horizontal (weft) threads in a
simple over-under pattern, forming durable plain-weave fabrics like canvas, widely used for bags,
shoes, and heavy-duty textiles due to its tight structure and strength.

### Twill Weave

Twill weaving creates diagonal lines by offsetting warp and weft threads in a step-like pattern,
producing durable fabrics like denim, commonly used for jeans, workwear, and jackets due to its
flexibility and abrasion resistance.

### Jacquard Weaving

Complex pattern weaving technology uses computer-controlled looms (e.g., Jacquard or Dobby systems)
to create intricate geometric or artistic designs in textiles, integrating multi-layered color and
texture for luxury apparel, upholstery, or cultural fabrics with digital precision.

### Warp & Weft

The longitudinal and transverse yarns (warp and weft) form fabric's structural base. Warp yarns
(stronger, tightly aligned) run lengthwise, while weft yarns interlace horizontally, defining
texture, drape, and strength. Fiber types (cotton, polyester, silk) and weave patterns shape
material properties for diverse applications.

### Knitting

Knitting is divided into weft (horizontal loops with a single yarn, e.g., T-shirts) and warp
knitting (vertical interlocking with multiple parallel yarns, e.g., lace), differing in elasticity,
unraveling risk, and machinery used for apparel or technical textiles.

The home of *award-winning* performance fabrics.

fabrics by pairing uncompromising craftsmanship with cutting-edge innovation test.

Our premium and intelligent fabrics elevate your senses in every way, while delivering unmatched
benefits in durability, cleanability, breathability and more.

* [Cabernet]
  
  # Brisa
  
  High-comfort meets high-functionality with Brisa. Diverse shades and a softly textured grain
  combine to make a go-to choice for interior projects — from upholstery to vertical and horizontal
  paneling. Ultrafabrics’ proprietary ventilation system promotes airflow for ultimate seating
  comfort, and notable acoustic properties help reduce noise when paired with appropriate
  components. 
  
  Brisa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
   
* [Breathable Distressed]
  
  # Brisa Distressed
  
  Brisa Distressed delivers a rustic, natural grain aesthetic with all the performance benefits that
  define our renowned Brisa collection. Engineered with breathable airflow technology, it delivers
  lasting comfort, reduced noise with its unique acoustic properties, and exceptional durability.
  Offered in a palette of earthy hues, Brisa Distressed suits a wide range of interior applications
  —from upholstery to vertical and horizontal panels.
  
  Brisa Distressed’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon.
  Each linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Breathable Forecast]
  
  # Brisa Forecast
  
  Boundary-pushing performance is the hallmark of Brisa Forecast. Climate control technology shields
  against temperature changes while breathability provides ultimate seating comfort and softness.
  Featuring water repellency, EPA-registered mildew defense, solar endurance, and colorfastness,
  it’s ideal for outdoor residential applications.
  
  Between its subtly textured aesthetic and palette of classic shades, Brisa Forecast brings
  understated style to any space — indoors or outdoors.
  
  Brisa Forecast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  *Formally known as Brisa Original Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*

# Ultrafabrics. Elevated.

Comfort|Design|Color|Performance|Sustainability|
We elevate every experience through innovative design - blending beauty, comfort, and performance to
set new standards for how materials enhance the way we live, work, and connect.
[Explore Markets][68]
[View Collections][69]
The home of *award-winning* performance fabrics.
For half a century, Ultrafabrics has continually reinvented the world of animal-free performance
fabrics by pairing uncompromising craftsmanship with cutting-edge innovation test.

Our premium and intelligent fabrics elevate your senses in every way, while delivering unmatched
benefits in durability, cleanability, breathability and more.
[About Us][70]
* [Cabernet]
  
  # Brisa
  
  High-comfort meets high-functionality with Brisa. Diverse shades and a softly textured grain
  combine to make a go-to choice for interior projects — from upholstery to vertical and horizontal
  paneling. Ultrafabrics’ proprietary ventilation system promotes airflow for ultimate seating
  comfort, and notable acoustic properties help reduce noise when paired with appropriate
  components. 
  
  Brisa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
   
* [Breathable Distressed]
  
  # Brisa Distressed
  
  Brisa Distressed delivers a rustic, natural grain aesthetic with all the performance benefits that
  define our renowned Brisa collection. Engineered with breathable airflow technology, it delivers
  lasting comfort, reduced noise with its unique acoustic properties, and exceptional durability.
  Offered in a palette of earthy hues, Brisa Distressed suits a wide range of interior applications
  —from upholstery to vertical and horizontal panels.
  
  Brisa Distressed’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon.
  Each linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Breathable Forecast]
  
  # Brisa Forecast
  
  Boundary-pushing performance is the hallmark of Brisa Forecast. Climate control technology shields
  against temperature changes while breathability provides ultimate seating comfort and softness.
  Featuring water repellency, EPA-registered mildew defense, solar endurance, and colorfastness,
  it’s ideal for outdoor residential applications.
  
  Between its subtly textured aesthetic and palette of classic shades, Brisa Forecast brings
  understated style to any space — indoors or outdoors.
  
  Brisa Forecast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  *Formally known as Brisa Original Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*
* [Breathable Frontier]
  
  # Brisa Frontier
  
  Brisa Frontier takes a rustic, natural aesthetic and infuses it with intelligent performance
  features: airflow circulation for breathable comfort, climate control technology to shield against
  temperature changes, solar endurance to prevent fading, water repellency, and EPA-registered
  mildew defense — just to name a few. Available in a versatile palette of classic hues, Brisa
  Frontier combines functionality and flexibility, making it perfect for residential outdoor
  application or indoor spaces across markets.
  
  Brisa Frontier’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each
  linear yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter. 
  
  *Formerly Brisa Distressed Outdoor. Outdoor applications for Residential use only.*

  Brisa Ellora embodies the perfect blend of aesthetics and functionality. Taking its meaning from
  the word “cloud”, its unique breathable technology ensures optimal comfort, making it an ideal
  choice for those who seek both style and substance. The combination of texture, durability, and
  functionality makes Brisa Ellora a premium choice for any space, including seating and acoustic
  applications.
  
  Brisa Ellora’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Brisa Fresco Flipped]
  
  # Fresco
  
  Breathable Comfort. Innovative Features. High-Style.
  Combining style and functionality, Fresco is a breath of fresh air. The collection is engineered
  with our proprietary breathable technology, which promotes airflow for ultimate seating comfort.
  When used with appropriate components, it features sound absorption properties in vertical
  applications. On top of that, inherent antimicrobial technology inhibits the growth of bacteria
  and other surface pathogens. With a texture reminiscent of leather across a palette of rich,
  classic neutrals, Fresco brings life to any design.
  
  Fresco’s blended backcloth includes REPREVE® recycled polyester and ECOVERO™ viscose. Each linear
  yard contains 8.3 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Coast Collections]
  
  # Coast
  
  Coast stands up to the elements while delivering superb style and comfort. Engineered to resist
  water, deflect against mildew and bacteria, and endure regular cleaning and disinfection, it’s
  ideal for outdoor, marine, and commercial spaces. Its enhanced UV resistance ensures colorfastness
  and our unique microfoam layer keeps surfaces cool to the touch. Inspired by the soothing
  qualities of the coastline, this collection features a soft pebble grain with a supple hand and a
  curated palette of natural, organic hues.
  
  Coast’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Pearlized]
  
  # Pearlized
  
  Pearlized adds a little shine to any setting. This fabric combines a classic, natural grain with
  subtle luminescence to deliver both style and luxury. Featuring a silken touch and a selection of
  chic hues, Pearlized is sure to add a distinctive statement to any design. But it’s more than
  beauty alone, this collection is a durable choice for sophisticated, sustainable style.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Pearlized contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* # Promessa
  
  Style meets stamina with Promessa, which features a pebbled texture and subtle sheen across a
  sizable range of neutral and deep tones. Bleach solution cleanable with a blended backcloth and
  industry-leading abrasion resistance, Promessa is ideal for high-traffic upholstery applications.
  Push the possibilities with Promessa.
  
  Promessa’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Pumice]
  
  # Pumice
  
  Profound protection and performance define Pumice. Its EPA-registered anti-mildew, antimicrobial,
  and antibacterial agents prolong the life of your designs. Colorfastness to sunlight,
  perspiration, chlorine, and seawater prevents fading. These powerful performance attributes,
  combined with the fabric’s understated textural surface make Pumice ideal for active settings —
  especially marine seating and high-exposure furniture. Pumice comes in thoughtfully curated
  neutrals sure to fit any color scheme.
  
  Pumice’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Summit]
  
  # Summit
  
  Innovative in both style and functionality, this fabric features moisture repellency, solar
  endurance, colorfastness, climate control technology, and EPA-registered defense against microbes,
  bacteria and mildew.
  
  Summit’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
  
  Summit is ideal for indoor and outdoor applications but is not suitable for marine exterior use.
* [Classic Tottori]
  
  # Tottori
  
  Inspired by the windswept landscape of the Tottori Sand Dunes in Japan, this collection features a
  timeless leather-like grain, matte finish, and a soft hand. Bleach cleanable with superior
  durability and a blended backcloth, Tottori is made to last. Offered in a range of earth-inspired
  shades with natural color variation, Tottori is ready for all upholstery applications across all
  markets.
  
  Tottori’s blended backcloth includes recycled polyester and FSC/PEFC-certified rayon. Each linear
  yard contains approximately 8 recycled plastic bottles or 9 bottles per meter.
* [Classic Ultraleather]
  
  # Ultraleather
  
  Reimagine the experience of leather. With a natural grain that’s soft and supple to the touch,
  Ultraleather boasts superior durability thanks to its 16-week hydrolysis resistance. Available in
  exclusive shades across a wide-ranging color palette, Ultraleather is ideal for any interior
  application.
  
  Supporting our use of rapidly renewable resources, the backcloth of Ultraleather contains 100%
  FSC/PEFC Certified Rayon.
* [Classic Pebble]
  
  # Pebble
  
  Cutting-edge Durability. Anywhere Shades.
  Pebble is meticulously engineered and extremely resilient, providing protection that lasts.
  Ensuring the fabric’s preservation for years on end, Pebble is equipped with EPA-registered
  anti-mildew defense and UV endurance. With its organic granular pattern, Pebble is a timeless
  addition to any design vision, indoors or out. Pebble is available in 2 neutral shades guaranteed
  to fit in anywhere.
